title: Naive Prompt Optimization: Rethinking the Need for Complex Prompt Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.27266v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficiently improving autonomous agents across diverse tasks is central to accelerating recursive self-improvement (RSI) in agentic AI, with prompt optimization emerging as a promising approach capable of delivering performance gains comparable to those achieved by fine-tuning model weights, while reducing computational costs in both optimization and serving. However, recent developments increasingly favor unnecessarily complex prompt optimizers. We introduce Naive Prompt Optimization (NPO), a lightweight single-lineage method that iteratively revises prompts using a teacher model with rollout feedback. NPO achieves comparable or better performance than GEPA with fewer rollouts, and its advantage increases with stronger teacher models, suggesting that stronger teacher reasoning can partially substitute for optimizer-side search complexity. In interactive games, NPO remains broadly competitive with GEPA, while GRPO performs better on some

translated_title: 朴素提示优化：重新思考复杂提示搜索的必要性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27266v1 公告类型：新 摘要：高效改进跨多样任务的自主代理是加速代理型AI中递归自我改进（RSI）的核心，提示优化作为一种有前景的方法，能够提供与微调模型权重相当的性能提升，同时降低优化和推理阶段的计算成本。然而，近期发展越来越倾向于不必要的复杂提示优化器。我们引入了朴素提示优化（NPO），这是一种轻量级单谱系方法，利用教师模型和回滚反馈迭代修订提示。NPO在更少的回滚次数下实现了与GEPA相当或更好的性能，并且其优势随着教师模型强度的增加而增强，表明更强的教师推理能力可以部分替代优化器侧的搜索复杂性。在交互式游戏中，NPO与GEPA保持广泛竞争力，而GRPO在某些方面表现更优。
tldr: 本文提出朴素提示优化（NPO），一种轻量级单谱系方法，通过教师模型和回滚反馈迭代修订提示，在减少计算开销的同时达到与复杂优化器相当或更优的性能，并证明更强的教师推理能力可部分替代搜索复杂性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Naive Prompt Optimization (NPO), a lightweight single-lineage method that iteratively revises prompts using teacher rollouts, achieving comparable or better performance than complex optimizers with fewer rollouts, and showing that stronger teacher reasoning can partially substitute for search complexity.
